ideas.idea: Confirm deployed routes and crawler responses live (item 1)
ideas.why: This is a check outside the code, so it isn't a code recommendation, and it applies to any site.

ideas.idea: Add concrete booking details (dates, price, location, booking route) to classes page
ideas.why: classes.html only says 'Book early' with no dates, price or booking route, so the page lacks the facts people ask about.

ideas.idea: Add address, hours and collection instructions to the homepage
ideas.why: index.html mentions weekend collection but gives no address, hours or deadline.
Having no JSON-LD is a stated non-problem and not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph/Twitter social preview metadata
ideas.why: It is accurate because index.html has no such tags, but it is standard advice that mainly affects link previews.

ideas.idea: List the actual breads with varieties, availability and prices on breads.html
ideas.why: breads.html claims over twenty loaves but names only two, so the content is thin.

ideas.idea: Provide allergen information or a linked details page
ideas.why: The allergen notice only says 'Ask us about allergens', so adding real information is a concrete improvement; data-nosnippet itself is fine.

ideas.idea: Add class specifics: duration, dates, price, venue, booking link
ideas.why: This is accurate for classes.html but duplicates the earlier booking-details note.

ideas.idea: State collection address, hours and ordering deadline
ideas.why: This is accurate for index.html but duplicates the earlier address/hours note.
It is accurate because the sitemap has no lastmod, but it is a small effect on a three-URL site.

ideas.idea: Link related content (booking, availability, breads) from the classes page
ideas.why: classes.html has only the global nav and no contextual links to breads or booking.

ideas.idea: Run the tool's fix command to apply item 1
ideas.why: Item 1 is just a confirmation step, so there is nothing for the command to change.
